home.subtitle: I'm {{companion}}. We'll take this one breath at a time.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A gentle companion to help you smoke less — at your own pace.

consumption.title: Your smoking, today
consumption.subtitle: No judgment — honest numbers help me build the right plan.

profile.title: A little about you
profile.subtitle: This personalizes your health timeline. All optional.

triggers.title: When do cravings hit?
triggers.subtitle: Pick the moments that ring true. We'll plan around them.

readiness.title: Where are you at?
readiness.subtitle: There are no wrong answers.
readiness.confidence: How confident are you about cutting back?
readiness.firstCig: When's your first cigarette after waking?

rationale.cold_turkey: You're ready and smoke lightly — a clean break can work best for you.
rationale.gradual_reduction: A steady taper fits you better — we'll ease down at a kind pace.

plan.criticalWindow: Your first {{days}} days matter most — I'm right here.
plan.noPlan: No plan yet — finish onboarding to get started.

progress.easeBody: The last few days ran a little high — and that's okay. We can stretch the plan to a gentler pace.
progress.accelBody: You've been comfortably under target. Want to finish a little sooner?

health.title: Your recovery
health.disclaimer: General wellbeing information, not medical advice.

pulse.title: Pulse & pressure
pulse.body: Your heart rate and blood pressure begin to settle back to normal.

co.title: Blood oxygen
co.body: Carbon monoxide clears and your blood oxygen returns to normal.

nicotine.title: Nicotine clears
nicotine.body: Most nicotine has left your body and your mood starts to steady.

senses.title: Taste & smell
senses.body: Nerve endings recover, so food tastes and smells better.

breathing.title: Easier breathing
breathing.body: Your bronchial tubes relax and your energy lifts.

circulation.title: Circulation
circulation.body: Circulation improves and moving around feels easier.

lungs.title: Cleaner lungs
lungs.body: Cilia regrow, so you cough less and feel less short of breath.

lungFunction.title: Lung capacity
lungFunction.body: Your lung function keeps climbing noticeably.

heart.title: Stronger heart
heart.body: Your risk of heart disease is now about half that of a smoker.

lungCancer.title: Lower risk
lungCancer.body: Your risk of lung cancer drops to about half that of a smoker.

craving.title: Hang in there 🫧
craving.subtitle: This urge will pass. Let's ride it out together.

timer.message: Cravings usually peak and fade within a few minutes. Stay with me.
timer.done: You did it. The wave passed. 🌊

distraction.intro: Pick one and do it right now:

items.water: Drink a glass of water, slowly.
items.gum: Chew gum or brush your teeth.

notifications.triggerBody: This is a usual moment for a cigarette. Want to try 2 minutes with me instead?
notifications.situationalBody: Tricky moment? Tap for a quick breath or a craving timer.

screens.about: Made with care, on your device.
screens.settings: Language, profile, notifications, and your data.
